recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered psychedelic collage featuring a central portrait integrated with socio-political imagery, defined by vibrant neon gradients and flat graphic shapes against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central large-scale portrait as the primary container for color gradients
Peripheral vignettes of flags, architecture, and groups of people framing the center
Juxtaposition of high-contrast black-and-white photography with saturated neon fills
Top-aligned geometric typography balancing the complex lower composition
coreInvariants: White border/background framing the entire collage
Use of halftone textures within photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive central face occupies 70% of the canvas, acting as a window into a colorful landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white-rimmed sunglasses of the central figure provide a high-contrast focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top typography, move down through the central face, and then spiral outward to the smaller narrative vignettes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of white space at the top and edges to contain the dense, chaotic central imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neon pink, cyan blue, and lime green forming a vertical spectrum gradient.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black and deep forest green for photographic shadows and architectural details.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red and yellow used sparingly in flags and small graphic icons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the center transitioning to stark white at the margins.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy browns or muted earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Open counters with intentional gaps in the stroke (stencil-like)
Strictly circular curves and straight horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is a perfect circle with a small gap at the top
The 'A' lacks a crossbar or has a detached one

treatment.fill: Dark brown or black with subtle texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-weight geometric display face used for all text to maintain a clean, modern contrast to the busy collage.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric roots and monolinear weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a psychedelic collage on a white background. Center a large face with a pink-to-blue gradient. Surround it with high-contrast black and white images of a capitol building, flags, and groups of people in graduation gowns. Add small yellow jet silhouettes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a geometric stencil-style sans-serif font in all caps across the top margin. Ensure the text is dark and has wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the central gradient vibrant and neon?
Are the photographic elements high-contrast black and white?
Is the typography perfectly horizontal and top-aligned?
Is there a clear white border around the composition?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the central figure
postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone texture in shadows
Ensure no overlapping of text and central face
Verify the presence of the white background frame
Confirm the stencil gaps in the lettering are consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast B&W Photography] + [Neon Vertical Gradient] + [Geometric Stencil Typography] + [White Negative Space] to create a 1970s soul-inspired collage.
